decisions.reason: The sliding-mandrel keyway groove does not change the fabrication sequence or pre-weld and post-weld surface rules for POS 1, POS 2, and POS 3.
Adding the keyway groove to the sliding mandrel does not change the bushing's fit, guidance, retention, or existing-hole requirements.
The source specifically requires a missing keyway groove on the sliding mandrel; it does not reverse the separate instruction to omit the keyway shown in cross section C-C of the main shaft.
The keyway-groove correction does not change any specified material.
The sliding-mandrel groove is unrelated to the required 45-degree angle between lug hole axes.
The model-delivery requirement remains unchanged; the missing groove is already captured as a feature requirement for the sliding mandrel and does not alter the obligation to provide a 3D model.
Adding the sliding-mandrel keyway groove does not change the assembly-based drawing-numbering rule.

The requirement to provide a complete drawing set remains valid unchanged; the groove correction is owned by the sliding-mandrel feature Requirement rather than changing the drawing-set deliverable definition.
